findings.title: No Agent-Consumable API Interface
findings.description: The application exposes a SOAP 1.1 RPC/encoded endpoint defined by a hand-maintained WSDL that drifts from implementation. No REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface exists. Modern agent frameworks cannot bind to SOAP/WSDL natively.
findings.gap: No REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface. SOAP RPC/encoded is deprecated and not consumable by agent tool frameworks.
findings.recommendation: Create a REST API wrapper (e.g., Spring Boot @RestController) exposing POST /orders with JSON request/response and auto-generated OpenAPI specification.

findings.title: Unreliable Machine-Readable Spec
findings.description: A WSDL file exists but is hand-maintained, drifts from the implementation, and uses deprecated RPC/encoded style that is not WS-I compliant.
findings.gap: Machine-readable spec exists but is unreliable (known drift from implementation) and uses deprecated format.
findings.recommendation: Auto-generate OpenAPI spec from annotations in the replacement REST API to ensure spec stays current.

findings.title: Unstructured Error Responses
findings.description: Error responses are unstructured strings: 'ACCEPTED:<poNumber>' or 'ERROR:<raw exception message>'. No error codes, no structured bodies, no retryable/terminal distinction.
findings.gap: No structured error format. Agents cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured JSON error responses with error code, message, and retryable boolean in the replacement REST API.

findings.title: Non-Idempotent Write Endpoint
findings.description: The submitOrder endpoint performs INSERT INTO partner_orders with no idempotency key, no duplicate detection, and no unique constraint enforcement. Same request creates duplicate records.
findings.gap: No idempotency key support, no unique constraint on (partner_id, po_number), no deduplication logic.
findings.recommendation: Add UNIQUE constraint on (partner_id, po_number) and implement idempotency key support in the replacement API.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency mechanism exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The submitOrder endpoint performs a raw INSERT with no deduplication. Under write-enabled scope, agent retries will create duplicate purchase orders.

findings.title: SOAP XML Response Format
findings.description: Responses are SOAP XML (RPC/encoded style) with simple string content. Complex for LLM consumption.
findings.gap: SOAP envelope adds unnecessary complexity for agent consumption.
findings.recommendation: Use JSON as the response format in the replacement REST API.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission. Order submissions produce no events, webhooks, or message queue publications.
findings.gap: State changes invisible to external systems. Event-driven agent patterns impossible.
findings.recommendation: Publish order events to SNS/EventBridge in the replacement architecture.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation
findings.description: No rate limits documented. No rate limit headers returned. Agents have no signal to self-throttle.
findings.gap: Agents cannot self-regulate call frequency.
findings.recommendation: Document rate limits and return X-RateLimit-Remaining and Retry-After headers.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: No machine identity authentication mechanism exists in the codebase. README mentions WS-Security username token (plaintext) but no implementation is present. No OAuth2, API keys, or mTLS.
findings.gap: No agent-attributable machine identity mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 client credentials flow or API key authentication with principal attribution.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: All callers share the same database credential. No IAM policies, no role differentiation, no mechanism to scope agent access.
findings.gap: Cannot limit agent access to specific operations or resources.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 scopes or IAM-based RBAC in the replacement REST API.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No permission checks on the submitOrder method. Any caller can execute any operation without restriction.
findings.gap: Cannot enforce action-level access control (read vs write vs delete).
findings.recommendation: Implement action-level authorization checks in the replacement service.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No identity propagation. Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user. All requests treated identically.
findings.gap: No user context propagation through the service.
findings.recommendation: Implement JWT-based identity propagation or OAuth2 token exchange.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials in Source Code
findings.description: Database credentials hardcoded in source: DB_PASS = 'partner2009', DB_USER = 'partner_app'. No secrets management, no rotation. Credentials in version control.
findings.gap: Hardcoded credentials with no rotation. Exposed to anyone with repository access.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation. Remove hardcoded values.

findings.title: No Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging of any kind. No logging framework, no CloudTrail, no write-operation attribution. Cannot determine who initiated operations.
findings.gap: No audit trail for agent write operations. Cannot prove compliance or conduct forensics.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured audit logging with immutable storage (CloudTrail or S3 Object Lock).

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents must have full audit attribution. No logging framework or audit trail exists for any operation in this service.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke individual agent identities. Cannot isolate misbehaving agents without taking down the entire service.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent without disrupting all callers.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-agent API key management with revocation capability.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback
findings.description: Immediate INSERT with no compensation or rollback capability. No saga pattern, no undo endpoint, no compensating transactions.
findings.gap: Cannot reverse agent-initiated writes. Failed multi-step workflows leave partial state.
findings.recommendation: Add order status lifecycle (PENDING → CONFIRMED → CANCELLED) with cancel/void endpoint.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no rollback/compensation mechanism exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The submitOrder method immediately commits an INSERT with no compensation logic. Under write-enabled scope, agent-initiated writes cannot be undone.

findings.title: Write-Only Interface — No Queryable State
findings.description: No query endpoints. The service is write-only — accepts orders but provides no way to inspect current state.
findings.gap: Agents cannot read before writing. No GET/query endpoints.
findings.recommendation: Add query endpoints (GET /orders/{id}, GET /orders?partnerId=X) in replacement API.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, no version fields, no ETags. Concurrent submitOrder calls create duplicate or conflicting records.
findings.gap: No protection against race conditions from concurrent agent instances.
findings.recommendation: Implement optimistic locking with version columns or unique constraints.

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience
findings.description: No circuit breakers, no retry logic, no timeout configuration. Raw JDBC connection with no pooling. Database failures cascade directly to callers.
findings.gap: No resilience patterns. Runaway agent loops cascade through database dependency.
findings.recommendation: Implement connection pooling (HikariCP) and circuit breaker pattern (Resilience4j).

findings.title: No Rate Limiting
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway, no WAF, no application-level throttling. Agent traffic storms would overwhelm the database.
findings.gap: No protection against runaway agent loops.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway with usage plans and throttling. Add WAF rate rules.

findings.title: No Transaction Limits — Unbounded Blast Radius
findings.description: No transaction limits. No maximum records per caller, no spend limits, no bulk operation caps. Agent error blast radius is unbounded.
findings.gap: No configurable limits on agent-initiated actions.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-caller transaction limits (max orders per hour, max amount per order).

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state. All writes immediately committed. Orders cannot be proposed for human review.
findings.gap: No mechanism for agent-proposed writes to await human confirmation.
findings.recommendation: Add order status lifecycle (PENDING → CONFIRMED) with confirmation endpoint.

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval gates. No configurable operation-level flags, no approval workflows. All operations execute immediately.
findings.gap: Cannot require human approval for high-risk agent operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates (e.g., orders above threshold require confirmation).

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No sandbox or staging environment. Manual SOAP-UI testing only. No safe environment for agent testing.
findings.gap: First agent bug discovered in production.
findings.recommendation: Create containerized staging environment with synthetic test data.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Exposed in Error Responses
findings.description: Stage A: YES — partner financial data and hardcoded DB credentials. B1: Raw exception messages expose DB connection strings and infrastructure details to callers. B2: No access control differentiation. B3: No classification metadata.
findings.gap: B1: Raw exceptions expose DB details. B2: Single shared credential for all callers. B3: No classification.
findings.recommendation: Immediately sanitize error responses. Implement access differentiation. Add data classification tags.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND B1 fired (sensitive infrastructure details in error responses).
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: DATA-Q1 B1 fired because error responses return raw Java exceptions containing DB connection strings (jdbc:oracle:thin:@10.0.9.30:1521:PARTDB) and potentially SQL statements with partner data.

b1.reasoning: Raw exception messages returned to callers expose DB_URL, table names, and potentially SQL with partner data.

b2.reasoning: Single shared DB credential (partner_app/partner2009) for all callers. No OAuth scopes, no role differentiation.

b3.reasoning: No formal data classification metadata, tags, or PII detection tooling.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls
findings.description: Partner financial transaction data stored with no residency documentation, no region-specific configuration, no sovereignty controls.
findings.gap: No jurisdictional classification for financial transaction data. Cannot assess compliance risk for agent LLM transmission.
findings.recommendation: Document data residency requirements. Classify whether data falls under GDPR, LGPD, PCI-DSS.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND partner financial data has no residency controls.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system stores partner purchase orders with monetary amounts in Oracle DB. Under write-enabled scope, an agent transmitting this financial data to an LLM in another jurisdiction cannot assess compliance risk.

findings.title: No Input Validation — Active Injection Vulnerabilities
findings.description: No input validation. SQL injection via string concatenation with partnerId and XML-parsed values. XXE vulnerability via unprotected DocumentBuilderFactory. No schema enforcement or size limits.
findings.gap: Active SQL injection and XXE vulnerabilities. No validation at API boundary.
findings.recommendation: Use parameterized queries (PreparedStatement). Disable external entities. Add XML schema validation and input size limits.

findings.title: No Temporal Metadata
findings.description: No timestamps in database records (no created_at, updated_at, event_time). No freshness signaling in responses.
findings.gap: Cannot determine when data was created or its freshness.
findings.recommendation: Add created_at (UTC) and updated_at columns. Include timestamps in API responses.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Leaked in Error Responses
findings.description: Raw exception messages returned to callers can expose DB connection strings, SQL statements, and partner data. No PII/sensitive-data redaction.
findings.gap: No redaction in error responses. Infrastructure details and potentially PII leaked.
findings.recommendation: Replace raw exception returns with generic error codes. Log full details server-side only.

findings.title: No Data Quality Awareness
findings.description: No data quality monitoring, no completeness metrics, no duplicate detection logic.
findings.gap: No signal about data accuracy or completeness for agents.
findings.recommendation: Implement data quality metrics in replacement architecture.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or Contract Stability
findings.description: No schema versioning. WSDL has no version identifier. No breaking change detection, no contract tests, no CI/CD.
findings.gap: No API versioning or contract stability guarantees. Agent tool bindings break silently.
findings.recommendation: Implement API versioning and contract tests (Pact) in replacement service.

findings.title: Partially Meaningful Field Names
findings.description: Field names partially meaningful (partnerId, amount) with some abbreviations (po, poXml). Database columns readable but poXml schema undocumented.
findings.gap: poXml opaque about expected XML structure.
findings.recommendation: Use fully descriptive names and structured JSON fields in replacement API.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog, no metadata layer. Data model only inferable from INSERT statement in source code.
findings.gap: Building agent tools requires reverse-engineering data model from source.
findings.recommendation: Document data model and publish to data catalog as part of modernization.

findings.title: Zero Observability — No Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No distributed tracing, no structured logging, no correlation IDs. No OpenTelemetry, no X-Ray, no logging framework. Agent-initiated requests completely opaque.
findings.gap: Cannot trace, correlate, or diagnose agent-initiated requests.
findings.recommendation: Implement OpenTelemetry SDK with trace ID propagation and structured JSON logging.

findings.title: No Alerting Configuration
findings.description: No alerting on error rates or latency. No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection.
findings.gap: Service degradation affecting agents goes undetected.
findings.recommendation: Configure CloudWatch alarms for error rate and p99 latency.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC. Infrastructure (JBoss AS 5.1, RHEL 6, Oracle 11g) managed manually. No peer review, no drift detection.
findings.gap: No IaC governance. Infrastructure changes manual and unauditable.
findings.recommendation: Define all replacement infrastructure as code (CDK or Terraform).

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD. Manual Ant build with hand-run wsgen/wsimport. No automated testing, no contract tests.
findings.gap: API changes cannot be caught before production.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with API contract testing for replacement service.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No automated rollback. Manual WAR deployment only. Cannot quickly revert bad deployments.
findings.gap: Recovery from bad deployments is manual and slow.
findings.recommendation: Implement blue/green or canary deployment with automatic rollback.

findings.title: Zero Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests. README states: 'No tests; partner onboarding is a manual SOAP-UI session.'
findings.gap: No automated validation of API behavior.
findings.recommendation: Implement comprehensive API test suites (integration + contract tests) running in CI.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest configuration. Oracle 11g with no evidence of TDE or KMS. Partner financial data stored unencrypted.
findings.gap: Data at rest not encrypted. Breach exposes all partner order data.
findings.recommendation: Use KMS-encrypted managed databases (RDS with encryption) in replacement architecture.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no evidence of long-running operations (>30s) in this service.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority assigned, no critical path evidence.

evaluations.title: Selective Query Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — service has no list/query endpoints with potentially unbounded results.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: No metrics or telemetry surface of any kind exists — informational signal, no finding emitted. Informational-absence suppression applied.

items.summary: Resolve all 7 BLOCKERs and address critical RISK-SAFETY findings. Focus on machine identity, audit logging, API modernization, and data protection.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY and RISK-QUALITY findings. Build observability, engineering maturity, and deployment safety.
Address INFO-level and remaining RISK-QUALITY findings. Improve agent developer experience and documentation.

recommended_actions.action: Modernize to REST API with OpenAPI specification
recommended_actions.rationale: SOAP endpoint is not consumable by agent frameworks. REST with OpenAPI unblocks all downstream agent integration.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy centralized identity provider with OAuth2
recommended_actions.rationale: No machine identity exists. Cannot scope permissions, enforce action-level auth, or suspend agents without identity infrastructure.
Write-enabled agents must have full audit attribution for compliance and forensics.
Agent retries create duplicate records. Failed workflows leave partial state. Both are data integrity risks.
Hardcoded credentials in source code are immediately exploitable via prompt injection or agent bugs.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy API Gateway with rate limiting and throttling
recommended_actions.rationale: No protection against runaway agent loops. Machine-speed traffic storms would overwhelm the database.
